name: Neo DPM++ 2M CFG++ with flow branch
plain: Neo-Sampler's 2M CFG++ adds a separate branch for CONST model sampling, which core 2M CFG++ does not have. Otherwise close to the core form.
math: CONST: t=half-log-SNR, α=σe^t. x0_mix=−(σ′/σ)α_s x0_u − α_t(e^{−h}−1)(1/(2r))(x0−x0_prev_u). x=α_t x0 + x0_mix + (σ′/σ)x.
